A playing technique that rivaled the pros.
I already knew it would happen, but that was exactly why—

Since this is a beginner's class, just relax and have fun with it!
All right, let's begin!

I getcha. I mean, it was fun, okay? Fun, sure... yeah!
It was fun, but...

In that case, let's both play guitar♪
It totally feels like the ultimate band instrument, right? See? Matching~♡
—And she aimed right on the line, too... That's totally insane...
—...Was that ball moving at the speed of a bullet train or what...?!
(Whizzzz)

Hey, maybe we should try bass or acoustic guitar, too!
Since there's two of us, layering different sounds together sounds super fun!

To think you'd have a talent for flower arrangement too...
Pandora-chan... you're too much of a genius!! I love it so much~!!

Fusaichi Pandora chatted away happily.
Could it be that, perhaps—
Right? Right? I really am pretty amazing, aren't I~~~♪
Being in a band with you, huh... Ahaha, that might not be half bad~?
Maybe the two of us could pack a dome someday—ehehe♪
Screeech! And then... what next~?!

Today was the day to look for hobbies with Fusaichi Pandora.
I just hoped we could find something she could thoroughly enjoy—
Magnificent!!
Huh?
—Pfft... Ahahaha! What was that?!
Teehee, do you think you can even do it~?
Huh? ...What do you mean, how...? Just, like, loosen up your grip when you hit it??

Nah, back when we played tennis, you did that and sent the racket flying!
You gonna be okay? Maybe our vibes just don't match—
Just so you know, Professor Pandora doesn't go easy on anyone, okay~?
—And from that day on, intense training began.
...Huuuuummmmm...?
Yay☆ See, that didn't take any time at all♪

Wouldn't a mellow song with an unexpected contrast be cool? Something emotional!
Or wait, maybe we should go for high-energy hype after all?
And then—

Even to an untrained eye, the colors and overall balance were flawless.
It was easy to see why the flower arrangement teacher was in awe.

Huuuh? Me?
...Are you sure you wanna ask me?

Aha! You're actually keeping up with me!
Then, then, how about this~?

So—after training ended the following day,
I called Fusaichi Pandora to a certain location.

Like, go totally limp for just a split second.
And then, BAM! Kind of like that?

!? Did you hear that?! We did it!!
That means we totally rocked it, right?!

Umamusume are athletes. Starting with sports seemed like a safe bet.
On top of that, a flashy sport that suited her tastes would be—

Hum-dee-dum♪ Which flower should I pick~?
Oh, this one's super cute! Wait, that one over there is gorgeous too~!
(Clap clap clap clap)
—And so, the two of us reached for our guitars.

The rustic simplicity of nature! A motherly warmth that envelops it all!
This is the true essence of Japanese wabi-sabi! —How breathtaking!!

She picked her favorite flowers from the selection before her.
And began arranging them, but...

How's that? Playing scales straight from the textbook is, like, totally boring~
If it were me... like this! ☆
――...Ohoooo?

Hey, hey! Do you wanna, like, for real try it? A two-piece band!
It totally screams "youthful springtime of life" and all!!
All riiiiight!!

...It seems she really can master any sport flawlessly.
In that case, something "tranquil"—we headed to a flower arrangement class next.

Man, you two were incredible! Totally in sync, too.
Forming a two-piece band together might actually be super fun!

Huh, a band workshop? First step is picking an instrument? Let's see...
Hey, what are you gonna pick?

Right here, it goes strum-strum-strum――
and then... zzzrriiing! Come on, you do it too!

Tossing the ball up high.
Keeping my focus on the ball――I kicked off the ground.
How's that? How is itttt☆ The colors and overall look are totally perfect, right♪

Oh, practicing, huh?
Look, look, your fingers are slipping off! Times like this――
(Wham!)
W-Whoaaa, for real!?

Fusaichi Pandora had breezed through everything so far without breaking a sweat.
Which meant I needed to throw an even bigger curveball her way.

Hmm♪ Hmm♪ Hmmm♪
I won~der what we'll find~♪
...Ummm... why did it feel like you threw the racket?
What!? No way, being a beginner with fingering like that... You're kidding, right?
